data.name: Samu
data.long_meaning: One who protects or is a deity. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sama’ meaning ‘equal’ or ‘protect’ and the suffix ‘u’ indicating a male or a god.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine protector, remover of obstacles and bestower of blessings. Can be used as a name for a child born under the auspicious influence of the Sun or Fire element.
data.numerology_meaning: Signifies new beginnings, leadership, and independence. Encourages self-confidence and creativity.

in_hindi.name: समूह

in_tamil.name: சமு
